purpose: Conservative product release gates recorded before scoring the new authored phrase fixture. These are engineering targets, not statistical confidence or general Cantonese accuracy claims.
release_action: Withhold installation/publication while expanded review is incomplete or any required gate fails. Preserve original scores and failure cases; do not change targets or thresholds after seeing ranks.

authored_coverage.reported_examples_and_short_controls: Report separately; do not substitute them for new quality cases.
authored_coverage.spelling: Plain ASCII Yale without tone letters/marks, derived from explicit Jyutping readings; not observed human keystrokes.
authored_coverage.review: Independent reading and spelling checks before rank scoring; preserve any uncertainty and exclusions.

authored_quality_required_for_each_profi.exact_match: Full intended text only; no partial output, alternate orthography or later-page relabeling.

additional_required_input_group.scope: At least15 authored ordinary negative phrases with ng replacing the syllabic m input for 唔 only, matching the user habit.

external_replay.baseline: ca015cc 1.0.6 engine with the same current dictionary and mapping modules; isolate imports.
external_replay.interpretation: Retained externally annotated corpus replay; overlap and prior development use preclude a held-out accuracy claim.

correctness.stress: Dense ambiguous and maximum-length inputs must terminate with bounded candidates or explicit capacity status; never silently claim exhaustive results after truncation.

performance.measurement: Dedicated serial changing-query run after concurrent quality jobs finish; disclose machine/run, cold initialization and engine-only scope. No OS or IPC deadline claim.
performance.cold_start: Record separately; do not mix into warm-query percentiles.
performance.stress_latency: Report separately from ordinary typing; watchdog termination is not a successful engine termination.

reporting.personal_history: Do not read or modify personal learning for this campaign.
reporting.historical_evidence: Do not overwrite prior frozen reports or imply source tests are installed x64/visual acceptance.
reporting.publication: Existing native installation/publication approvals do not override this explicit hold pending confidence.

native_acceptance.after_engine_quality_passes: Build a fresh x64 package, install through standard Setup, verify installed hashes/registration/owned broker and public phrase lookups; preserve user learning, appearance and input preferences.
native_acceptance.scope: Engine/protocol tests on this Windows computer alone cannot certify TSF integration or live application typing.
native_acceptance.user_visual_check: User owns live application/game acceptance as previously requested.
